pl-l4d24c1-d1e115.summary: Turns to the consideration of sacred ordination.

pl-l4d24c1-d1e118.summary: States that there are seven grades or orders of spiritual offices, as the Fathers plainly teach and as shown by the example of our head, Jesus Christ, who exercised the offices of all in himself and left the same orders to be kept by his body, the Church.
claims: There are seven orders, exemplified by Christ.

pl-l4d24c1.summary: Turns to sacred ordination: there are seven grades or orders of spiritual offices, as the Fathers teach and Christ's example shows, who exercised all these offices himself and left the same orders to be kept by his body, the Church.
claims: Christ exercised all the orders himself and left them to the Church.
